unique_primary_replay_estimate.basis: deduplicated by checkpoint method × dataset/case × training seed and actual producer invocation; excludes all non-primary experiment grids
unique_primary_replay_estimate.H2_replay_basis: One V4-checkpoint replay per structural case and seed produces informative-teacher plus three counterfactual-arm outputs; the 16 contrast rows share those invocations. Current frozen H2 producer calls engine.predict/replays itself and does not consume frozen graph-diagnostic trace artifacts.

reuse.H1_V4_structural_prediction: Included in the 20 H1 V4 graph diagnostic runs that also supply four-case pre/post TV; do not count a separate ordinary V4 forecast pass if producer saves/binds predictions.
reuse.H1_noise_prediction: Already emitted with V4/V9 noise-only diagnostics.
reuse.H2_contrasts: Four H2 contrasts share one H2 V4 replay per case/seed; current H2 producer performs a distinct replay, so not deducted against H1 trace runs.
reuse.H1_V9_structure: No graph-state trace required by structural H1; V9 structural forecasts are ordinary predictions.

capacity.estimate_scope: Per complete test collection; conservative uncompressed bound, not actual on-disk size. Compression is not assumed. 1.25× disk check is per replay, not campaign-wide reservation.

secondary_scope.robustness_trace_count: not inferable from primary registry; no bound pretest-selected method/case/seed trace queue found. N64 estimate applies only to same shape/history/origin count; real collections differ.

existing_artifact_check.search: runs/**/*.trace-rows.jsonl.gz and graph/train/trace-named files; no matches

unknowns: P4 checkpoints, policies, output paths/caps and per-job input plans are not bound in the structural registry.
Actual graph trace compression/file size and H2 output size are unknown.
The 30-trace count is the registry-defined four structural V4 responses plus noise-only V4/V9 traces, five model seeds.
N64 extrapolation assumes same per-collection bound across those 30 jobs; it is not an actual disk/runtime forecast.
C: free space is an instantaneous measurement. 30×14-GiB caps exceed current free space; raw-estimate scenario leaves about 24.7 GiB before H2/ordinary/other outputs and safety margin.
